mapper.select: select id,level1_ratio,level2_ratio from course_distribution_commission_config where id=1
select id from course_distribution_commission_config where id=1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into course_distribution_commission_config(id,level1_ratio,level2_ratio,update_time) values(1,#{level1Ratio},#{level2Ratio},now()) on duplicate key update level1_ratio=values(level1_ratio),level2_ratio=values(level2_ratio),update_time=now()
mapper.update: update course_distribution_commission_ledger set status='REVERSED',reverse_time=now() where order_no=#{orderNo} and status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select * from ( select l.id, 'COMMISSION' as recordType, l.commission_level as commissionLevel, l.status, l.commission_amount as amount, l.beneficiary_user_id as beneficiaryUserId, l.order_no as orderNo, l.course_id as courseId, null as direction, null as reason, l.create_time as occurredAt from course_distribution_commission_ledger l union all select m.id, 'MANUAL' as recordType, null as commissionLevel, null as status, m.amount, m.beneficiary_user_id as beneficiaryUserId, m.order_no as orderNo, m.course_id as courseId, m.direction, m.reason, m.occurred_at as occurredAt from course_distribution_finance_manual_record m ) r order by r.occurred_at desc,r.id desc

select coalesce(sum(case when commission_level=1 and status='ACTIVE' then commission_amount else 0 end),0) as level1Amount, coalesce(sum(case when commission_level=2 and status='ACTIVE' then commission_amount else 0 end),0) as level2Amount, coalesce(sum(case when status='REVERSED' then commission_amount else 0 end),0) as reversedAmount, coalesce((select sum(amount) from course_distribution_finance_manual_record where direction='CREDIT'),0) as manualCreditAmount, coalesce((select sum(amount) from course_distribution_finance_manual_record where direction='DEBIT'),0) as manualDebitAmount from course_distribution_commission_ledger
